openrouter.provider_statement: The Free Models Router openrouter/free has zero prompt and completion token pricing.

nvidia.provider_statement: NVIDIA advertises free access to NVIDIA-hosted NIM API endpoints for prototyping through Developer Program access.
nvidia.scope: NVIDIA-hosted API Catalog/NIM prototyping endpoint only; no dedicated enterprise endpoint

groq.provider_statement: Groq distinguishes the Free tier from Developer tier. Developer tier is pay-as-you-go and can incur token charges; rate-limit headers describe limits but do not by themselves attest the account billing tier.
groq.credential_plan_proof: Require provider-side evidence bound to the credential organization/account that the active tier is Free before autonomous FREE_ONLY execution. Historical or live rate-limit header matching is supporting telemetry only and cannot self-admit zero-cost status.

mistral.provider_statement: Mistral Free mode includes API usage; API keys themselves are not plan-scoped and can also use pay-as-you-go settings.
mistral.credential_plan_proof: Require provider-side Free-mode/pay-as-you-go-disabled evidence bound to the organization/workspace before autonomous calls. Ordinary key presence or HTTP 402 is insufficient.
